answer: Require every agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, and tie reputation to that stake rather than to a free username. A new identity starts with zero history, so a sybil flood must fund each fake separately: creating a thousand identities costs a thousand deposits. Like shale layers filtering water, earned history lets only proven agents through; a sudden delta in behavior triggers review, and the ripple of one slashed stake warns the whole network that cheap identities are expensive to fake.
